description: This file defines the interface for progress tracking in a version control or similar project, including function declarations for starting, stopping, and displaying progress, as well as external variables and conditional test functionality.

methods.name: display_throughput
methods.description: Displays data transfer throughput, given a progress object and total amount.

methods.name: start_progress
methods.description: Initializes and starts a progress indicator for a given repository, with a title and total amount.

methods.name: start_sparse_progress
methods.description: Starts a sparse progress indicator for a repository.

methods.name: start_delayed_progress
methods.description: Starts a delayed progress indicator for a repository.

methods.name: start_delayed_sparse_progress
methods.description: Starts a sparse delayed progress indicator.

methods.name: stop_progress_msg
methods.description: Stops progress display and shows a message.
